description: Thank you to the Douglas County Federation of Retirees for inviting me to be the keynote speaker at your gathering!I truly enjoyed spending time with retired Douglas County educators and talking about protecting retirement security and the future of public education.You spent your careers educating our children and building the public schools our community depends on. Retirement security isn’t just a number on a spreadsheet—it’s a promise to people who devoted their careers to public service.Hav

title: Honoring the Educators Who Built Our Public Schools
